fee_notes: Standard fee is $150,000 payable in 4 installments. Reduced programs: New franchisee purchasing multiple franchises ($70,000), existing franchisee 2nd franchise ($85,000), existing franchisee 3rd+ franchise ($70,000), Vet*Fran ($125,000), Designated Target Market ($125,000). Only one program may be applied per agreement.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Fee is $150,000. The Initial Fee is payable in installments... You could pay less if You qualify for one of the Initial Fee reductions described in Item 5.
